prerequisites: Student posses basic knowledge of fluid mechanics.
Student can solve diferential equations of mathematical models of hydraulis components and systems.
Student possess basic knowledge of classic mechanics.

learning_outcomes.text: In the result of lesson student should be able to define requirements for hydraulic fluids of hydrostatic drive systems.
In the result of lesson student should be able to describe working pinciple of basic components of hydrostatic system.
In the result of lesson student should be able to characterize of working of basic hydrostatic drive systems.
In the result of lesson student should be able to analyse operation of hydrostatic components and systems.
In the result of lesson student should be able to calculate basics parameters of hydrostatic drive system.
In the result of lesson student should be able to interpret basic characteristic of hydrostatic components and systems.
In the result of lesson student should possess ability of information analysis with diferent complex level.
In the result of lesson student should possess ability of objective argument evaluate, efficient explanation and justification own opinion with help of knowledge of hydrostatic drive systems.
In the result of lesson student should possess ability of follow the rules valid in academic environment.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, lecture range presentation, check form, requirements.
Basic symbols of hydraulic and pneumatics components.
Contaminations - sources, reasons and results - filtration.
Positive displacement pumps - systematics, characteristics, efficiencies.
Hydraulic and volumetrics losses in displacement machines and in the system.
Introduction, laboratory range presentation, check form, requirements.
Experimental determination properties of working fluid - bulk modulus.
Experimental determination resistance character in hydraulic pipes - linear resistance.
Local resistences in hydraulic systems. Orifice as a local resistance - cavitation effect.
Static characteritics of conventional directional control valve.
Description of transient states in hydraulic systems - experimental determination of basic dynamic factors.
teaching_methods: traditional lecture with the use of transparencies and slides
self study - preparation for laboratory class
assessment_rules: The lecture is credited with a grade based on F1 (colloquium). The laboratory is credited with a grade based on F1 (test, report, oral response).
